Follow [[Master Ranger Nente]] in order to destroy the [[Charr]] patrol in [[Old Ascalon]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
| profession = ranger
}}

===Objectives===
* Hunt down and destroy the Charr patrol.

===Reward===
* 250 [[Experience]]
* 50 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* {{skill icon|Feral Lunge}}
* {{skill icon|Favorable Winds}}

==Walkthrough==
Nente will immediately start to run, heading south. While he is passing several points on the map fighting against the creatures on that way, the quest will be updated at each point. At the final quest marker you will reach a little wooden bridge where 5 [[Charr Stalker]]s are standing. After you have killed them, you can immediately talk to Master Ranger Nente for your reward.

You do need to follow Nente to the quest markers, as he will stop moving if you follow a path far enough away from the one he is taking.

==Dialogue==
===Initial Dialogue===
;Master Ranger Nente
:''"Several days ago, a '''Charr patrol''' broke through the breach created by [[Duke Barradin]]'s [[Ascalon Vanguard|Vanguard]]. They have been stalking innocent people here behind the [[Great Northern Wall|Wall]]. Their depredations must not be allowed to continue. I go now to hunt these fiends; it would be my honor if you would accompany me. What do you say?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = Let the hunt begin.
| decline = More pressing tasks await me.
| ask = Let us track down these beasts! Follow me!
}}

===Intermediate Dialogue===
;At the start, and after kneeling at certain points (five times total) <!--first time does not appear in chat log-->
:'''Master Ranger Nente:''' ''"The tracks lead off in this direction."''

===Reward Dialogue===
;Master Ranger Nente
:''"This particular group of Charr will threaten us no more. However, I fear that more of them might be heading this way; This group has the look of scouts. We need to dicover the base camp where they are staging these assaults, and destroy it."''

==Notes==
* If Nente dies or is stuck on some certain point, you may have to start the quest again.  (Sometimes, if Nente is stuck, clicking on him will cause him to continue.)  Even if you kill the Charr patrol and the quest is updated in your quest log, you won't be able to gain the reward from Nente. 
* Make sure your party is able to make enough damage and to heal enough, if possible also Master Ranger Nente. Every time he kneels it is better to wait for him to ensure that the quest will be updated and Nente will head forward on his way.
* The [[Charr Stalker]]s also spawn before accepting or completing the quest. If they are killed beforehand, Nente still has to reach their location for the quest to be completed.
